# Packt Subscription

> > Packt Subscription is a comprehensive learning platform providing access to technical books, courses, and resources covering software development, testing automation, and IT technologies.

The platform offers in-depth technical documentation and tutorials for developers, testers, and IT professionals. Content includes practical guides on testing frameworks like Selenium, web technologies, and programming techniques with hands-on examples and best practices.

## Key Topics

- Selenium WebDriver
- Element Location Strategies
- CSS Selectors
- XPath
- jQuery Selectors
- Test Automation
- findElement Methods
- Web Testing
- Selenium Testing Tools
- Browser Automation
- DOM Navigation
- Locator Strategies

## Selenium Testing & Automation

- [Locating Elements | Selenium Testing Tools Cookbook](https://subscription.packtpub.com/book/all+books/9781849515740/1): Selenium element location guide using CSS, XPath, and jQuery selectors
